subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT one of the determinants of demand?

options.text: Future expectation to change in price

solution:
The correct answer is the __**Taste and preference of the seller.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The taste preference of the seller is **not** a **determinant of demand** because it depends upon the **taste preference of buyers or individuals.**
 
• Taste and Preferences of consumers are **influenced by advertisements, changes in fashion, climate, new innovations etc.**
 
• **Demand** for those goods **increases** and consumers develop a strong taste preference**.**
 
• If the taste or preference of a product is **fading (decreasing),** its demand will **decrease**.
 
• The demand function is D×= f(Px,Pr,Y,T,E)
 
 
• Px = Price of own community
 
• Pr = Price of related goods
 
• Y = Income
 
• T = Taste in Preference of buyers
 
• E = Expectations.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Future expectations**:- If the consumer expects an **important change in the ability **of the commodity in near future, he may decide to change his** present demand for the commodity** which leads to a raise in his present demand for the commodity at its existing price.
 
• **Income of consumer**:- change in the income of the consumer also **influences his demand for different goods**. The demand for normal goods tends to **increase with the increase in income** and vice versa.
 
• Price of goods:- demand for a commodity is also influenced by **changes in the price of related goods**.
 
• There are of two types:

 (a) **Substitute Goods**

 (b) **Complementary Goods.**
